newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-America West rated outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-America West rated outperform.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Brain Harris started coverage of America West Airlines Inc with an outperform rating.
-- Harris said the company appears to be on the road to recovery after correcting many of the problems that contributed to a disappointing third quarter.
-- He remains concerned about a possibly overambitious growth plan and higher year-over-year capacity increases in the carrier's late night Las Vegas markets.
-- Market share gains against Southwest Airlines in Phoenix, and benefits from planned system upgrades, are encouraging, he said in a research report.
